title: conxiOS.com — home page manifesto
abstract: The full-scroll landing page for conxiOS. States the framework's central claim in the site's own words: "The same architecture that shows up in ancient philosophy, neuroscience, depth psychology, and systems theory. Nine universal needs. Six core emotions. Three fundamental drives. A zero state that holds it together. Not invented. Discovered." Frames AI alignment as downstream of human self-alignment ("You can't align AI with humans when humans aren't aligned with themselves") and lists eight domains conxiOS claims to address: AI Alignment + Conscious Technology, Personal Growth + Human Potential, Organizational Evolution + Conscious Business, Education + Emotional Intelligence, Wellness + Mental Health, Media + Entertainment, Social Impact + Global Movements, Governance + Leadership Evolution.
